title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I go from Mumbai to a place in Kokan which is 250 km away but on the way I pass through my native place which is about 3 km from the place I visit 1812 views Q. Agar Masjid main Kharji hissa na ho aur kabhi kabhi jamat e sani karni ho to kya kar sakte hai aur uska kya tareeqa hoga? 2405 views Q. While travelling and having Qasar Namaz if a namaz like Zuhr was Qaza, how to make the Qaza in the journey itself? 40649 views Q. Plz give me details about(Fatwa: 1268/1268/M=1431) i.e if the farz salah starts and he is reading sunnah and if he has completed one rakat and then he should complete 2nd and then join the farz salah. 1776 views Q. If adahn is going on ,is it correct to do abluation, going to toilet or any other act or we have to wtill adhan is complete? 2191 views Q. Qasr Salah 1948 views Q. Level of Sin if somebody offfered Salah in impure state. 6603 views Q. Tahajjud in congregation & women attending Jummah salaah and Tarawih in mosques 9049 views Q. I work in Saudi Arabia and go back home after every one year. I belong to Nainital district of U.P. (Now Uttarakhand) which is very near to Bareilly and the Barelwi Maslak is rampant in that area. "Mazar parasti" and Urs, etc., are the foremost part of their Islam and Aqeeda. In my village there are only two mosques and the Imams leading the prayers are staunch Barelwi. I had a discussion with one of these Imams of our moque, he has the belief that to ask for help (Mannat) with the dead (Mazar) is as good as praying God. Since then, I stopped praying with him. I offer all my five prayers in my home during my vacation of one month or so. Secondly, my wife is very punctual in prayers and other Shariah matters. She also joins my prayers which I lead in my house. Please enlighten me on;(1)if, under the circumstances explained above, my prayers in my home are correct, (2) prayers led by me and joined by my wife are correct. or I should go the mosque and pray behing the same Imam as explained above. I shall highly appreciate your immediate reply on the above e-mail address. Best regards 2929 views Q. Moulana please tell us the starting and end time of salat Ishraq, Chasht, Awwabin? 3285 views Q. Assalamualikum Mufti Sb., What to do if one forget to recite Surah-Fatiha and only recited Zammu Surah in any Fard (Compulsary) Salaah(Namaz) / Wajib/ Nafil / Sunnah ? Will the sajda sahu will be sufficient in such case? 4085 views Q. If praying witr behind a shafai imam, when should a hanafi read his qunoot as shafai imam reads his qunoot after rising from ruku and in hanafi one has to read his qunoot before going to ruku. Will witr be valid if qunot is not read before ruku. 5323 views Q. Performing four rakaats instead of Qasr Salaah as a Musafir is a sin and contrary to the Sunnah Kindly confirm me, If we have chance to make Namaz beside Imam(Imam Jamat sa), during this time what we should do. (i.e) whether we(Musafir) should make Namaz by separately or we should made Namaz beside Imam ? Your earlier quote will be greatly appreciated. 4292 views Q. (1) Occasionally I will be praying "Tahajjud Salah" and "Salatul Hajah" during 3rd part of the night. 6834 views Q. Azkar after fardh salah 4077 views

Question: Assalamualikum Mufti Sb., Accordingly to your Fatwa for the Question: 9179. If my aged is 45 then, I don't know how much Fard of Fajr salah I was missed (may be morethan 230), In this kind of situation, if I am not able to remember number of qadha salah made finally then in this situation what I should do. Durint this kind of situation Shall I make niyyat like "making qaza of first" bcos I was known like that only some our frineds. kindly confirm. Answer ID: 10916 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 348/301=D/1430) Have an estimation of missed prayers and pray them accordiingly. Yes, you can make the intention in the same way. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
